components.name: BIP39/BIP32 HD wallet derivation (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 + HMAC-SHA512 + secp256k1)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.3 is a committed lockfile entry — the pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 engine required by ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (package-lock.json:3234), which the web3/@truffle wallet stack installs. No direct hash.js call exists in the application's own source (this repo is a web3 arbitrage bot); the SHA family ships inside the installed dependency tree, and the lockfile line is exactly what the dependency inventory records. Changeable here only by changing the wallet-stack dependencies.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@3.3.0 is a committed lockfile entry (block at package-lock.json:2480) and ships an MD5 implementation among its modules. There is no MD5 call site in the application source; MD5 rides along inside an installed dependency. Presence in the shipped tree is what this inventory records — use is a separate question.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@3.3.0 lockfile entry (package-lock.json:2480) ships a SHA-1 implementation among its modules. No SHA-1 call site in the application source; it is present because the containing package is installed by the web3/0x stack.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 4 sites are real lockfile lines: secp256k1@^4.0.1 and its @types stub are required by ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (package-lock.json:3228, :3240) and the package block sits at :5504, types at :1076. This is the native ECDSA engine of the Ethereum toolchain — the same curve the bot actually signs transactions on at runtime (web3.eth.accounts.wallet.add(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY) at src/index.js:23, signing getFlashloan txs at :335). The curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol: observable here,

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 is the lockfile's EC workhorse: required by dozens of packages in the tree (web3, @0x, ethereumjs, hdkey stacks) to provide ECDSA/ECDH over secp256k1. No direct elliptic call exists in the application's own source; it executes inside web3 transaction signing and 0x order-signing internals. Complements ALG-673c8f24 (native secp256k1 package) — same curve, pure-JS implementation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 9 sites are real lockfile lines for the pbkdf2 npm package: requirements at ^3.0.3/^3.0.9/^3.0.17 come from the web3/ethereumjs wallet stack — ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 requires pbkdf2@^3.0.17 at package-lock.json:3236, resolved entry pbkdf2@3.1.1 at :5133, plus @types/pbkdf2 stubs (:1054, :3227) that document the library's presence. PBKDF2-HMAC is used by those libraries for BIP39 mnemonic→seed and V3-keystore derivation; no direct PBKDF2 call in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js (resolved 2.0.4 in the lockfile) is the scrypt KDF used by the Ethereum keystore (V3 wallet) encryption path inside ethereumjs-wallet/ethereum-cryptography — the wallet stack that @truffle/hdwallet-provider and web3 install. No direct call in application source; ships with the dependency tree. Related: the scrypt algorithm object ALG-c1f8b585 records its requirement positions.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.11 is a committed lockfile entry — the pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-256 engine that pbkdf2@3.1.1 itself requires (package-lock.json:5139) to build its HMAC primitives. Part of the browserify-compatible crypto shim the web3 stack installs; no direct call in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 is a committed lockfile entry and the most-required crypto package in the tree (web3, @0x, ethereumjs, hdkey). It provides the ECDSA recorded as ALG-710f61f0 and ECDH over secp256k1; no direct call in application source — it executes inside web3/0x signing internals.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.3 is a committed lockfile entry providing the SHA family recorded as ALG-50e53f84; required by ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (package-lock.json:3234) and used internally by elliptic. No direct call in application source; ships with the web3 wallet stack.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.1 is the resolved lockfile block for the PBKDF2 algorithm whose requirement positions are recorded as ALG-4de3b020 (package-lock.json:5133-5141, requiring create-hash/create-hmac/ripemd160/sha.js itself). No direct call in application source; executes inside wallet/keystore derivation in the web3 stack.
